zh.d:
本版围绕「场景」与「记忆」大幅升级：工作/生活场景内置成套实用技能，工具审批方式可自己选择；助手记忆获得统一的「记忆空间」，召回更聪明、用过的记忆会说明；MCP 工具改为显式激活、不再后台自动授权。另有浏览器自动化过程可视化、上下文压缩入口、彩色反馈卡片与项目组邀请码登录等大量改进。

【新增】
· 【场景】工作与生活场景内置成套实用技能并刷新内置 MCP 通道；内置场景默认只启用推荐的少数技能，不再「全部带入」；场景卡片直接显示用途说明，可从卡片或会话徽章进入编辑；自有场景可选择工具审批方式（自动执行或逐次确认）
· 【记忆】资料库新增「记忆空间」：助手记忆集中管理、专属配色；回答会说明这一轮用到了哪些公司记忆；长记忆在回答后自动整理，所有 Agent 共用一个记忆页；未挂项目的会话共享同一份用户级记忆；召回只带请求真正提到的记忆，并按正文匹配只取合并文件中的相关段落
· 【知识库】会话产物可选择位置加入知识库；资料侧栏近期目录按编辑时间排序，展示企业来源与作者
· 【MCP 工具】工具改为显式激活（个人版上限 20 个），不再在后台自动弹 OAuth 授权；员工连接器不计入个人配额
· 【浏览器】Agent 浏览器自动化过程对用户可见
· 【聊天】上下文压缩入口移到用量指示旁，压缩过程中给出明确进度
· 【登录】登录渠道居中；LDAP 旁新增「项目组邀请码」入口，未登录协作者可用服务器本地账号加入项目组
· 【反馈】「QQ 与邮箱」联系卡片彩色展示，在线留言收到服务端回执才提示成功，失败保留草稿

【优化改进】
· 【更新日志】发版记录改为彩色版块卡片展示
· 【稳定性】取消长任务时正确回收子进程、进程树与提供方流；MCP 进程树与游离 SSE 监听按需回收；模型代理对异常结束的流留下日志便于排查
· 【场景】企业场景的 MCP 在进入会话前完成激活；头像与场景标题同行展示，描述卡片放开换行
· 【记忆】深色主题下记忆页可读性修复，卡片布局与提示文案优化

【修复】
· 【MCP】修复企业环境 OAuth 检查风暴；已禁用的浏览器连接器不再触发启动预检；连接器标签跨目录页保留；企业/个人 MCP 选择分离并强制 10/50 配额
· 【会话】对话回合运行中不再被切换模型
· 【技能】同名技能卡片按所在目录区分，不再互相覆盖；按名称引用技能的场景不再一次性导入全部技能
· 【知识库】侧栏选中行统一加粗；资料表长标题不再跨列，窄窗口适配
· 【企业】根据服务端能力展示项目组退出提示；项目组页管理后台入口统一到页首
· 【渠道】企业微信（WeCom）配置字段修复，可正常启用
· 【保险箱】中文文件名可正常下载；上传前预检文件大小

企业治理与目录能力增强：钉钉通讯录支持整目录同步，消息扫描总开关接入实际执行点，资源下发工作台重设计并支持草稿确认，项目组退出与企业成员关系分离。

【新增】
· 【目录】钉钉通讯录支持整目录同步；目录映射归属在部门上直接可见；目录重叠错误给出归属映射与解除路径并本地化展示
· 【安全】消息扫描总开关接入实际执行点，策略随规则同步下发；移除无执行点的消息脱敏开关避免误导
· 【管理台·资源下发】工作台重设计并分页优化授权目录；批量选择先生成草稿、确认后才提交、可放弃；资源详情展示授权来源并支持就地确认调整
· 【连接器】飞书连接器凭据通过令牌交换校验，配置错误即时暴露

【优化改进】
· 【项目组】项目组退出/移除不再影响企业成员身份，主动退出保留登录；企业默认协作空间与普通项目组在客户端与管理台明确区分
· 【MCP】企业 MCP 授权列表按类别/状态/标签筛选并显示限额；无消费者链的实验室能力隐藏；企业配额范围明确并强制批量原子选择
· 【报表】渠道行按显示名合并，采纳率分母改为当前成员；报表口径、向导与审计体验收尾
· 【保险箱】文件上传错误提示可读化
· 【管理台】授权编辑器在刷新时保持挂载；注册提示与实际发布行为一致

【修复】
· 【报表】高管表读取字段名修正，不再显示 $NaN
· 【组织】目录映射重叠错误信息可读且可操作

en.d:
Scenes and memory take a big step forward: work/life scenes ship with practical built-in skill bundles and let you choose how tools are approved; the assistant's memory gets a unified Memory Space with smarter recall that says what it used; MCP tools are now activated explicitly instead of silently authorizing in the background. Browser automation is now visible, context compaction is one click away, feedback cards got color, and project-group invite codes join the login screen.

[New]
· Scenes: work and life scenes bundle practical skills and refresh built-in MCP transports; built-in scenes start with a few recommended skills instead of "all"; a scene's card states what it is for and opens the editor from the card or the conversation badge; scenes you own can choose how tools are approved (auto or per-call)
· Memory: a new Memory Space in the library centralizes the assistant's memory with its own look; an answer can say which company memories it used; long memories tidy themselves after a reply, and all agents share one memory page; projectless conversations share one user-level memory directory; recall brings in only the memories a request mentions and, by matching text, only the relevant sections of a merged file
· Knowledge: conversation artifacts can join the library at a chosen location; the sidebar's recent list sorts by last edited and shows enterprise origin and authors
· MCP tools: tools are activated explicitly (personal cap 20) with no unattended OAuth prompts; employee connectors stay outside the personal quota
· Browser: agent browser automation is visible to the user
· Chat: context compaction sits beside the usage indicator with clear progress while running
· Login: sign-in channels are centered; a project-group invite code entry joins LDAP, and external collaborators can join with a server-local account
· Feedback: colorful contact cards under "QQ and email"; online messages confirm success only on a server receipt and keep the draft on failure

[Improved]
· Update log: release notes render as color-coded edition cards
· Stability: cancelling a long task reaps child processes, process trees and provider streams; MCP process trees and detached SSE listeners are reaped; the model proxy logs streams that end badly
· Scenes: enterprise scene MCPs activate before the chat opens; avatars sit on the title row and description cards wrap
· Memory: the memory page reads well in dark themes with better card layout and tip text

[Fixed]
· MCP: the enterprise OAuth check storm is gone; a disabled browser connector no longer triggers startup preflight; connector labels survive catalog paging; local and enterprise MCP selection are separated with 10/50 quotas enforced
· Conversations: a running turn no longer has its model swapped
· Skills: same-named skill cards are distinguished by folder instead of overwriting each other; a scene naming skills no longer imports every imported skill
· Knowledge: selected sidebar rows are consistently bold; long table titles no longer bleed across columns on narrow windows
· Enterprise: the project-group leave hint follows server capabilities; the admin-console entry on the project page is unified
· Channels: WeCom configuration works again with the correct credential fields
· Vault: Chinese filenames download correctly; upload size is pre-checked

Enterprise governance and directory capabilities grow: DingTalk directory sync covers whole directories, the message-scan master switch reaches its enforcement point, the resource-grant workbench is redesigned with draft confirmation, and leaving a project group no longer touches company membership.

[New]
· Directory: DingTalk directory sync covers whole directories; a department shows which mapping owns it; directory-overlap errors name the owning mapping and the unblock path, localized in the console
· Security: the message-scan master switch is wired into enforcement and policies sync with rules; a redaction switch with no enforcement point was removed to avoid misleading admins
· Console/resource grants: the workbench is redesigned with paginated authorization directories; batch choices become an explicit draft, submitted only after confirmation and discardable; resource details show the grant's origin with in-place adjustments
· Connectors: Feishu connector credentials are validated through a token exchange, surfacing bad configuration immediately

[Improved]
· Project groups: leaving or being removed from a project group no longer deletes company membership, and a voluntary leave keeps the sign-in; the enterprise default space is distinguished from ordinary project groups in both client and console
· MCP: enterprise grant lists filter by category, state and tags and show limits; laboratory capabilities without a consumer chain are hidden; enterprise quotas are scoped and selections apply as batched atomic updates
· Reports: channel rows merge by display name and the adoption denominator is the current membership; report semantics, wizards and audit polish are wrapped up
· Vault: file upload errors read like human advice
· Console: the grant editor stays mounted across refetches; registration copy matches actual publishing behavior

[Fixed]
· Reports: the top-members table read the wrong field names and no longer renders $NaN
· Organization: directory-mapping overlap errors are readable and actionable
